description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.7-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed WAV albums showing year 0
- Fixed WAV files tagged by other programs showing no album name
- Fixed editing a WAV cutting its full release date down to the year
- Fixed album quality badge showing Lossless for mixed albums
- Fixed ReplayGain scans making MP3s hang on a silent tail
- Fixed blurry and jagged album art
Added
- Added ReplayGain scanning for any files from the queue
- Added Add files button to the ReplayGain scanner
- Added Mixed quality badge for albums with lossless and lossy tracks
- Added Tint Whole Window option for album pages
Improved
- Improved ReplayGain scanner with per-row checkboxes
- Improved artist page Sort buttons
- Improved artist page favourite star animation
- Improved cover art resizing across the app
Full Changelog: v1.5.6...v1.5.7
